title: Fortnite's Sprite Spree Week: Catch 'Em All Before the Season Ends!
summary:
Have you been hunting for sprites in Fortnite? Well, get ready, because Sprite Spree Week is coming! Starting Saturday, Aug. 15, the game will boost the spawn rates for different sprites each day. That means you'll have a much better chance to catch the ones you're missing. It's like the game is throwing a party and all the sprites are invited!

First up, on Saturday, there's a special event called the Unstable Story Moment. At the same time, the first set of Mythic Hours begins at 2 p.m. EDT. During those two hours, you might see some super rare sprites. Then, from Sunday to Wednesday, each day will focus on a different sprite: Galaxy, Holo, Cube, and Gem. Each one will have increased spawn odds for 24 hours straight. That's a whole day to hunt for your favorite!

But wait, there's more! During Sprite Spree Week, you'll also start every game with a Lucky Sprite Locator. This handy tool helps you find sprites faster. You'll also earn double sprite XP, so you can level up your sprites quicker. And guess what? There's no sprite dust cost! That means you can use your sprite powers without worrying about running out of dust.

Oh, and here's a cool tip: the Fortnite teaser shows a campfire. That might mean you can earn sprite XP just by resting at a campfire. So if you're tired from all that hunting, take a break and warm up by the fire!

Remember, your sprites will carry over as cosmetics into Season 4. So this is the perfect time to finish your collection. Don't wait too long—the season is almost over. Check the schedule, mark your calendar, and get ready to catch 'em all!
why_it_matters: If you play Fortnite, this is a chance to grab rare sprites before they become only cosmetic items, and it shows how a little planning around event times can help you finish a goal.
